svg.title: Three quadratic forms drawn as surfaces
svg.desc: Left: a bowl, the height of a positive definite matrix. Middle: a saddle, the height of an indefinite matrix, rising along one axis and sinking below zero along the other. Right: a tilted bowl, steep along one diagonal and shallow along the other.
svg.text: grey floor: the plane of x; height above the floor is x⊤Ax; blue is above zero, orange below zero; the dot is the origin
